title: Run your first investigation
summary: Open a case, add several IOCs at once, put a raw log date on the timeline, and hand a task to a colleague.

steps.title: Welcome
steps.body:
A **case** holds everything about one investigation: indicators, timeline, tasks, notes, evidence. You will open one and fill it the quick way.

Everything you create is real data. The case goes to the **IrisInitialClient** test customer, which dashboards and statistics leave out, and the last step offers to delete it.

steps.title: Open a case
steps.body: On the case queue, click **Open a case**.

steps.title: Fill in the case
steps.body: Give it a name and a short description, pick the **customer** and at least one **sector**, then click **Create**. The Fill buttons type the values for you.

fills.label: Case name
fills.value: Tutorial - phishing with a malicious link

fills.label: Short description
fills.value: A user clicked a link in a fake invoice email.

steps.title: Go to the IOCs
steps.body: Case #{caseId} is open. **IOCs** are the indicators of compromise: domains, IPs, hashes, accounts. Open the case, then its **IOC** tab.

steps.title: The section button
steps.body: The highlighted button always adds the kind of item of the tab you are on: an IOC here, an event on the Timeline, a task on Tasks. Click **Add IOC**.

steps.title: Several IOCs at once
steps.body: With **One IOC per line** ticked, each line becomes its own IOC: paste a whole list from a report or a mail header. Pick the type **domain** and a TLP, then click **Add IOC**.

steps.title: Go to the timeline
steps.body: The **timeline** tells what happened, in order. Open it.

steps.title: Add an event
steps.body: Same button, same place: click **Add event**.

steps.title: Paste the date as it is
steps.body: No need to retype dates from logs. Click the **wand** next to the time, paste the date exactly as the log prints it, and click **Submit**: the date, time and time zone are filled in.

steps.title: Save the event
steps.body: Give the event a title. You can also link it to the IOCs you just added, so it shows on their page. Then click **Add event** at the bottom of the form.

fills.label: Title
fills.value: User opens the fake invoice link

steps.title: Go to the tasks
steps.body: An investigation is shared work. Open **Tasks**.

steps.title: Hand out a task
steps.body: Click **Add task**, give it a title and a status, and pick who it is **assigned** to. Then click **Add task** at the bottom of the form.

fills.label: Title
fills.value: Block both domains on the proxy

steps.title: Notes, and what comes next
steps.body: **Notes** hold the write-up of the investigation. The **Summary** tab gathers the case, and its **...** menu turns it into a report. Close the case once the work is done: the tutorial **Hand over: report and close a case** walks through that.

steps.title: Clean up
steps.body: Case #{caseId} was for practice. Delete it now, or keep it to look around: cases of IrisInitialClient count in no dashboard.
